newsitem.title: SPAIN: Madrid stocks end firmer, more gains seen.
newsitem.headline: Madrid stocks end firmer, more gains seen.

text.p: Madrid stocks ended firmer on Monday, with dealers expecting further strength after a short period of consolidation.
The general index rose 1.54 points, 0.38 percent, to 405.72 and the Ibex added 15.70 points, 0.34 percent, to 4,683.50.
Iberdrola added 40 pesetas to 1,535 and Fenosa rose 24 pesetas to 1,000, with investors focussing on sector gains from expected lower money rates, dealers said.
Gas Natural meanwhile slipped 370 pesetas to 26,500 ahead of the announcement of the placement price for the government's 3.8 percent stake in the firm.
Telefonica rose 10 pesetas to 2,850, reversing early losses after it said it was still in talks to buy the rest of TISA.
The session was somewhat volatile, in heavy put-through dominated trade which totalled around 70 billion pesetas.
Underlying sentiment was still firm, with more gains anticipated after a period of limited losses.
Eyes were on tomorrow's regular Bank of Spain repo, with most expecting the central bank to leave key rates on hold at 6.75 percent, at least until November inflation data is out.
